## Plan — Mark overdue invoices

*Spec for work item \`wi*01M7YHTB6WQMAZCCPZJ19FACZ8`  (pipeline  `product\_work\`). Visible, not gated — the build starts from here.\_

### What changes

Today the `/invoices` table shows each invoice's raw status and nothing else, so a sent invoice outstanding for six weeks looks exactly like one sent yesterday.

After the change, a new pure predicate `isOverdue(invoice, today)` in `lib/invoices.ts` returns true only when `status === "sent"` **and** strictly more than 30 whole days have passed between `issuedOn` and `today`. Both are ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` strings compared with `Date.parse`, which treats the date-only form as UTC midnight — so the result does not depend on the server's timezone and no date library is needed, matching this repo's stated Dates pattern. `app/invoices/page.tsx` computes `today` once per render and renders a small inline-styled `Overdue` marker in the status cell of every row the predicate accepts. Paid, draft and void invoices never get the marker, whatever their age.

**One finding worth flagging.** `/invoices` is currently prerendered as a *static* page, and reading the clock in a server component does not change that — I added `new Date()` to the page and rebuilt, and the route table still reported `○ /invoices (Static)`. The overdue flag would therefore be frozen at build time, silently breaking "the 30 days are counted from today". So the page also gains `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`, with a comment saying why; rebuilding with that line reports `ƒ /invoices (server-rendered on demand)`, and both `tsc --noEmit` and `eslint .` stay clean.

**The CSV export is deliberately untouched.** `exportableInvoices`, `toCsv`, `CSV_HEADER`, `app/invoices/export/route.ts` and `components/ExportButton.tsx` all keep their current behaviour — the request asked about the table, and adding an overdue column to the file would change the one promise this app exists to make. No refactor is folded in, and the `30` stays a module-local named constant rather than becoming configuration.

### Files the build may touch

| File | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/invoices.ts` | The `isOverdue` predicate and its constant. |
| `lib/invoices.test.ts` | Tests for the predicate, including the boundary. |
| `app/invoices/page.tsx` | The marker in the status cell; the `force-dynamic` opt-out. |
| `app/invoices/page.test.tsx` | New — asserts which rows show the marker. |

Feature folders: `lib/`, `app/invoices/`.

### Acceptance checks

1. Load ` (localhost/redacted) the row for **INV-1002** (Northwind Books,  `sent` , issued 2026-10-11) shows  `Overdue\` next to its status.
2. On that page, **INV-1001** (Acme Bakery, `paid`, 2026-10-02) and **INV-1003** (Globex Coffee, `paid`, 2026-10-19) show no `Overdue`, even though both were issued more than 30 days ago.
3. On that page, **INV-1004** (`draft`) and **INV-1005** (`void`) show no `Overdue`.
4. ` curl -s (localhost/redacted) is unchanged: header  `id,customer,amount,issued\_on,status` , then three rows for INV-1001/1002/1003, no overdue column, and the word  `Overdue\` nowhere in the body.
5. The export button still reads exactly `Export 3 invoices as CSV`.
6. `npm run build` lists `/invoices` with the `ƒ` marker, not `○`.
7. `npm test` passes, including a case asserting a `sent` invoice issued **exactly 30** days before `today` is *not* overdue and one issued **31** days before *is*.

### Tests

**Added** — `lib/invoices.test.ts` gains a `describe("isOverdue")` block on the existing `invoice(over)` factory: sent at 31 days is overdue, sent at exactly 30 is not (the boundary, since the rule is "more than 30"), sent at 29 is not, and `paid`/`draft`/`void` at 100 days are each not overdue. New file `app/invoices/page.test.tsx` renders the page and checks INV-1002's row contains `Overdue` while the other four rows do not — stable over time, since paid/draft/void are never overdue and INV-1002 stays past the mark.

**Changed (declared)** — `lib/invoices.test.ts`. Nothing else; no existing test is modified or deleted.

### Notes

- As of today (2026-11-21) the seed ages are INV-1001 50d, INV-1002 41d, INV-1003 33d, INV-1004 20d, INV-1005 13d. INV-1002 is the only overdue row, and INV-1001/INV-1003 are the useful negatives: both older than 30 days, both `paid`.
- `.factory/sandbox/manifest.json` records "/invoices prerendered static" as an observed build fact. The `force-dynamic` line makes that one line of description stale; it breaks none of the manifest's *exercised* capabilities — the page is still built, still served, still answers 200 — but it is worth an amendment next time the manifest is refreshed.
- Web research was unavailable in this sandbox (hosted fetch/search disabled by policy), so the Next.js behaviour above was settled by building this repo rather than by reading nextjs.org; `force-dynamic` was confirmed against the installed Next 15.5.29 type declarations.
